name: ChurnZero
description: Let agents read your customer accounts in ChurnZero: contract value, renewal dates, licenses and products, health scores, contacts, product usage events, meetings and notes. For renewal decks, usage reviews and meeting prep.
identity: A ChurnZero user's API key. Agents read what that user's permission group may read in bulk, and change nothing.

setup.title: Turn on the REST API
setup.body: The ChurnZero REST API is an add-on. If your ChurnZero admin pages have no API Keys page, ask your ChurnZero Customer Success Manager to turn it on.

setup.title: Give a user only the access agents need
setup.body: Use a ChurnZero user for agents, in a permission group with the Developer Tools permission and only these bulk read permissions: Accounts, Contacts, Events, Meetings and Notes. Leave the other bulk read permissions off. The group's permissions apply to everyone in it, so a group of its own is safest.
click: In ChurnZero, go to Admin, then User Permission Groups, and create or open the agents' group.
Turn on Bulk Read - Accounts, Bulk Read - Contacts, Bulk Read - Events, Bulk Read - Meetings and Bulk Read - Notes. Leave every other bulk read permission off.
Add the agents' user to the group.

setup.title: Create an API key
setup.body: Signed in as that user, create an API key and copy it for the form below. Your ChurnZero address is the one you sign in at, such as acme.us1app.churnzero.net: enter the part before .us1app.
click: In ChurnZero, go to Admin, then API Keys, and create a new API key.

fields.label: ChurnZero instance
fields.help: The part before .us1app.churnzero.net in your ChurnZero address.

capabilities.label: Read accounts
capabilities.description: Find customer accounts by name, id, CRM id or renewal date, and read one: contract value, renewal and end dates, licenses, products, health and relationship scores, NPS and owner.
capabilities.note: Reaches every account unless you keep an agent to chosen accounts. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Read contacts
capabilities.description: List an account's contacts: names, emails and products.

capabilities.label: Read usage
capabilities.description: List product usage events by account, contact, event type and date, and the event types.

capabilities.label: Read meetings and notes
capabilities.description: List an account's meetings and notes: subject, date, attendees, summary and sentiment.
capabilities.note: Notes and meeting summaries hold what your team wrote about the customer.

limits.label: Accounts
limits.help: Optional: only these ChurnZero accounts, by their ChurnZero id (the number in the account's address). Leave empty for every account.

revoke: In ChurnZero, go to Admin, then API Keys, and delete the key. Agents lose access to ChurnZero at once.

tools.name: churnzero_list_accounts
tools.description: List customer accounts, soonest renewal first. Filter by part of the name, ChurnZero id, CRM id, external id, renewal date or active. Answers {items, next}; pass next as cursor for more.

name.description: Part of the account name (at least 2 letters)

crm_id.description: The account's id in your CRM

renewal_from.description: Next renewal on or after this date

renewal_to.description: Next renewal on or before this date

tools.name: churnzero_get_account
tools.description: Read one account by its external id (the id your systems send ChurnZero): contract value, renewal and end dates, licenses, product subscriptions, scores, NPS, parent accounts and owner.

tools.name: churnzero_list_contacts
tools.description: List an account's contacts, or find a contact by email. Answers {items, next}; pass next as cursor for more.

tools.name: churnzero_list_events
tools.description: List product usage events, newest first, by account, contact, event type and date. Each has a date, type, quantity and description. Answers {items, next}; pass next as cursor for more.

event_type_id.description: The event type id, from churnzero_list_event_types

from.description: Events on or after this date

tools.name: churnzero_list_event_types
tools.description: List the usage event types, to name the event type ids of events.

tools.name: churnzero_list_meetings
tools.description: List an account's meetings, newest first: subject, start and end, organizer, attendees, summary and sentiment. Answers {items, next}; pass next as cursor for more.

from.description: Meetings starting on or after this date

tools.name: churnzero_list_notes
tools.description: List an account's notes, newest first: title, date, text, contacts, topics and sentiment. Answers {items, next}; pass next as cursor for more.

from.description: Notes on or after this date
